headline: Prime Intellect Releases Verifiers v1: Composable Tasksets, Harnesses, and Runtimes for Agentic RL Training and Evaluations
context: Prime Intellect launched verifiers 0.2.0, previewing a rewritten "v1" core under the verifiers.v1 namespace. It splits an environment into a taskset (what), a harness (how), and a runtime (where), with an interception server that proxies requests and records training-ready traces

sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Prime Intellect launched verifiers 0.2.0, previewing a rewritten "v1" core under the verifiers.v1 namespace. It splits an environment into a taskset (what), a harness (how), and a runtime (where), with an interception server that proxies requests and records training-ready traces. Any taskset runs under any compatible harness, with full prime-rl training support at launch. The post Prime Intellect Releases Verifiers v1: Composable Tasksets, Harnesses, and Runtimes for Agentic RL Training and Evaluations appeared first on MarkTechPost .
